answer: A pre-written answer bank thus goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 39 aliases trips the duplicate check at the anchor gate. The forge receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, so that the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. A farm of 297 pays that 70 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
